*Acquisition aims to expand toxicology testing access nationwide and provide clinical insights to support patients living with chronic pain, substance use disorders and mental health challenges*


BURLINGTON, N.C., Nov. 4, 2026 –[Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/) (NYSE: LH), a global leader in innovative and comprehensive laboratory services, today announces it has completed its acquisition of Millennium Health, an accredited specialty laboratory with more than 15 years of experience in drug testing and surveillance.


Millennium Health provides critical insights into patients’ recent use of prescription medications and/or illicit drugs, helping clinicians more effectively monitor and treat individuals living with chronic pain, substance use disorders, mental health conditions and other health needs.


“The completion of this acquisition marks an important step in strengthening Labcorp’s toxicology capabilities and expanding access to these important testing services for patients across the country,” said Andrea Throop, Ph.D., Head of Toxicology at Labcorp. “By bringing together Labcorp’s national scale, scientific expertise and digital capabilities with Millennium Health’s deep experience in toxicology testing and drug surveillance, we are well positioned to support healthcare providers with actionable information that helps improve patient care and outcomes.”


Upon integration, patients, clinicians and Millennium customers are expected to benefit from Labcorp’s extensive test menu, patient service center (PSC) network of convenient locations across the U.S. and leading digital solutions to assist with test ordering and result delivery.


Hogan Lovells Cadwalader served as legal counsel for Labcorp, and Blank Rome served as legal counsel for Millennium Health.


**About Labcorp**
Labcorp (NYSE: LH) is a global leader of innovative and comprehensive laboratory services that helps doctors, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, researchers and patients make clear and confident decisions. We provide insights and advance science to improve health and improve lives through our unparalleled diagnostics and drug development laboratory capabilities. The company's nearly 71,000 employees serve clients in approximately 100 countries, provided support for more than 85% of the new drugs and therapeutic products approved by the FDA in 2025 and performed more than 750 million tests for patients around the world. Learn more at[www.labcorp.com](https://www.labcorp.com/) .
